Definition: from G1861; an announcement (for information, assent or pledge; especially a divine assurance of good):--message, promise.
BiblicalUsage: The promise — God's announced assurance of good. The promise He has promised us is eternal life in 1 John 2:25, godliness has promise of the life that now is and of that which is to come in 1 Timothy 4:8, and all the promises of God in Christ are yea and Amen in 2 Corinthians 1:20. The scoffers ask where the promise of His coming is in 2 Peter 3:4.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe every promise of God is yea in Christ — not maybe, not one day perhaps, but yes and Amen. I hold that the promise of His coming is the one the scoffers mock and the saints wait for, and I would rather wait with the saints than laugh with the scoffers.
RelatedPeople: John the Apostle; Paul; Simon Peter
